applicabilityBasis.summary: wsrUSD is Reservoir's yield-accruing savings position minted from rUSD. The public savings documentation describes governance-set interest accruing per block, while reserve documentation describes conversion into rUSD subject to PSM liquidity. The token represents a value-accruing protocol position rather than a fixed-monetary-value payment or settlement instrument.

genius.notes: wsrUSD is assessed independently from base rUSD as a yield-accruing savings position. This exclusion is a research application of the GENIUS payment-stablecoin definition, not a regulator decision on the named token or an exemption for the underlying rUSD. The legal token issuer is not identified in the opened product documents. The older terms and risk factors name rUSD, srUSD and trUSD but omit wsrUSD; their token-specific statements are not extended to this wrapper. Public protocol reserve disclosures do not establish independent monthly stablecoin reserve attestations. No official payment-stablecoin authorization is asserted.
